According to the method of variation of parameters, we should seek a particular solution yp(x)=u1(x)y1+u2(x)y2 that satisfies the following constraints: {u1′y1′+u2′y2′=x3e5xu1′y1+u2′y2=0

Given that u2(x)=∫g(x)dx, find the function g.

2.Finding a VOP Equation Using the Derivative Constraint?

Consider the differential equation y″−3y′+2y=x3e5x. The corresponding homogeneous equation has the fundamental solutions y1(x)=ex and y2=e2x.

Select the correct options in the reasoning below.

According to the method of variation of parameters, we seek a particular solution of the form
u1ex+u2e2x
u1ex+u2e2x
u1(ex)′+u2(e2x)′
u1′(ex)′+u2′(e2x)′
u1′ex+u2′e2x
yp(x)={(u1ex+u2e2x)(S0)} where u1=u1(x),u2=u2(x), that satisfies the constraint
u1(ex)′+u2(e2x)′
u1(ex)′+u2(e2x)′
u1ex+u2e2x
u1′(ex)′+u2′(e2x)′
u1′ex+u2′e2x
yp′(x)={(u1(ex)′+u2(e2x)′)(S1)}.

Differentiating yp with respect to x, we obtain

u1′ex+u1ex+u2′e2x+2u2e2x
u1′ex+u1ex+u2′e2x+2u2e2x
u1′ex+u1ex+u2′e2x+u2e2x
u1′ex+u1ex+2u2′e2x+u2e2x
yp′(x)={(u1′ex+u1ex+u2′e2x+2u2e2x)(S2)}.

Therefore, we have the following constraint equation relating u1′ and u2′:

u1′ex+u2′e2x=0
u1′ex+u2′e2x=0
u1′ex+2u2′e2x=0
u1′ex−u2′e2x=0
u1′ex−2u2′e2x=0

4.Finding a VOP Equation Using the Derivative Constraint?

Consider the differential equation y″+25y=cos⁡(3x). The corresponding homogeneous equation has the fundamental solutions y1(x)=sin⁡(5x) and y2(x)=cos⁡(5x).

Select the correct options in the reasoning below.

According to the method of variation of parameters, we seek a particular solution of the form
u1sin⁡(5x)+u2cos⁡(5x)
u1sin⁡(5x)+u2cos⁡(5x)
u1(sin⁡(5x))′+u2(cos⁡(5x))′
u1′(sin⁡(5x))′+u2′(cos⁡(5x))′
u1′sin⁡(5x)+u2′cos⁡(5x)
yp(x)={(u1sin⁡(5x)+u2cos⁡(5x))(S0)} where u1=u1(x),u2=u2(x), that satisfies the constraint
u1(sin⁡(5x))′+u2(cos⁡(5x))′
u1(sin⁡(5x))′+u2(cos⁡(5x))′
u1sin⁡(5x)+u2cos⁡(5x)
u1′(sin⁡(5x))′+u2′(cos⁡(5x))′
u1′sin⁡(5x)+u2′cos⁡(5x)
yp′(x)={(u1(sin⁡(5x))′+u2(cos⁡(5x))′)(S1)}.

Differentiating yp with respect to x, we obtain

u1′sin⁡(5x)+5u1cos⁡(5x)+u2′cos⁡(5x)−5u2sin⁡(5x)
u1′sin⁡(5x)+5u1cos⁡(5x)+u2′cos⁡(5x)−5u2sin⁡(5x)
u1′sin⁡(5x)+u1cos⁡(5x)+u2′cos⁡(5x)−5u2sin⁡(5x)
u1′cos⁡(5x)+u1sin⁡(5x)+u2′sin⁡(5x)−u2cos⁡(5x)
yp′(x)={(u1′sin⁡(5x)+5u1cos⁡(5x)+u2′cos⁡(5x)−5u2sin⁡(5x))(S2)}.

Therefore, we have the following constraint equation relating u1′ and u2′:

u1′sin⁡(5x)+u2′cos⁡(5x)=0
u1′sin⁡(5x)+u2′cos⁡(5x)=0
u1′cos⁡(5x)−u2′sin⁡(5x)=0
u1′sin⁡(5x)−u2′cos⁡(5x)=0
u1′cos⁡(5x)+u2′sin⁡(5x)=0
{(u1′sin⁡(5x)+u2′cos⁡(5x)=0)(S3)}
